independent_review.scope: fractional three-volume sharp-Hausdorff-Young analytic constants and endpoints in volume-stability REPORT
independent_review.endpoint_notes: alpha=q/2 is allowed via Plancherel; q=3/2 is excluded because the time envelope is exactly |t|^-1; alpha=0 and beta=1 are continuous/drop-factor endpoints

new_results.statement: If max diag P<=1/2 and rho=sqrt(3)||(I-P)M||op/s3(M)<sqrt(3/2)-1, choose q=(1+rho)^2 and obtain ||p_Q||_inf <= 3e/[(1+rho)(1-4rho-2rho^2)] e3(M^TM)^(-1/6). For M=M0+E this expands the diffuse-rank perturbation window to ||E||op/a<0.114853519868...; ||E||op<=a/10 gives <48.670/a.

Sharp D5 gives ||p_Q||_inf <= (5e/sqrt(2)) e5(M^TM)^(-1/10) without a marginal gate. If T=sum_{j>=3}s_j^2, R=T/s3^2>2, k=floor R, F3(R)=[C(k,3)+(R-k)C(k,2)]/R^3, then ||p_Q||_inf <= (5e/sqrt(2))F3(R)^(-1/10)(s1s2)^(-1/5)T^(-3/10). The proof uses exact cap-concentration minimization of e3 of the tail.

For Z4=e4(M^TM), row four-volume marginal h_i, row r_i and N=M without row i, h_i Z4 <= ||r_i||^2 e3(N^TN). If N passes the q D' gate, then ||p_Q||_inf <= 3e/((3-2q)sqrt(q)) h_i^(-1/6)(s2s3s4)^(-1/3). In particular h_i>=3/4 and residual third-volume marginals<=2/3 give <22.228(s2s3s4)^(-1/3).
If h_i=1, deleting row i forces an exact-rank-three cross block. Applying account03/B02 r17 gives ||p_Q||_inf <=6||r_i||^(1/3)Z4^(-1/6) <=6(s2s3s4)^(-1/3), continuous.

source_result_application: On the c2414ef PEER_TAIL stress family with m=512,N=510, sharp D5 yields ||p_Q||_inf <11.504 without the projection gate.
partner_application: account03/B02 r17 exact-rank-three theorem is applied to the exact four-volume coloop after physical row deletion, yielding the displayed <=6(s2s3s4)^(-1/3) inequality. Latest r18 Schur-gap bound ||p_q||_inf<=16|d|^-1/2 Delta^-1/4 was also consumed on the exact-rank-two aligned endpoint; its determinant-only critical branch remains open.
